patterns: APPSC asks single-fact items: instrument for humidity (hygrometer vs hydrometer trap), isohyet/isoneph, cloud producing rainstorms (cumulonimbus).
Match-the-cloud-appearance (cirrus silky, cirrostratus milky, cirrocumulus globular, cumulus cauliflower) and halo/rainbow optics are recurring.
AP angle: cloud-seeding chemical (silver iodide + sodium chloride, 2004), hydrological-cycle 'not a part' items.
Many PYQs filed here are physics/chemistry/current-affairs strays; real topic PYQs are short and definitional.
App MCQs lean to multi-statement and match items with more numeric detail (latent heat values, water budget BCM) than PYQs show.
